blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Французское слово «amour» пришло из окситанского языка через ___ (трубадуры), а иначе бы оно было «ameur».
exercises.prompt: The French word "amour" comes from the Occitan language through the troubadours, otherwise it would be "ameur".
exercises.why: Most information on Russian accusative prepositions was derived from here. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.
exercises.context: Most information on Russian accusative prepositions was derived from here. (From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0))
